Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts. We're pleased to hear that you found our service attentive and friendly. At Đu Đủ Xanh, we strive to offer a unique and enjoyable dining experience, and we're glad that you appreciated our efforts. 
We understand that Vietnam is home to a diverse array of outstanding vegetarian restaurants, each with its own distinct flavour and style. As you can see, for Ưu Đàm or Hum or Đu Đủ Xanh, we are offering different prices ranges, products/services and aiming to different market segment. We do respect and acknowledge the excellence of other vegetarian restaurants, which contribute to the vibrant culinary landscape of our country. 
Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to refine and enhance our offerings. We are dedicated to improving our dishes and ensuring that every guest leaves with a memorable experience. Delicious vegetarian food in a delightful old French villa
May 2022 • Couples
Stumbled across this place by accident, but we had a fantastic meal! I actually remember the venue from years before when it was a different Vietnamese restaurant. Now it serves high class Vietnamese vegetarian food - in a atmospheric setting. Beautiful old tiles on the floor, plenty of plants and greenery and great service. 

We ate a selection from the starters and main courses. Everything we tried was delicious. I really liked the chả nấm mối (little blocks of termite and wood ear mushrooms, tofu, egg white, piper lalot leaf served with lemongrass dipping sauce). The drinks were also very good - I had something with a fresh chili slice floating in it - and it was remarkably refreshing!!

Lovely place - and we will be returning soon to explore more of the menu (which had handy English translations)
